proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly places Khowar śuɣur sand, from earlier *śiguδ, in the *śikatā branch of sikatā. The survey x spellings are retained as local transcription variants. The entry discusses Iranian interaction and uncertainty in the broader family, so this is a source-based family assignment rather than a claim of wholly regular development.
